mapper.sql: id, conversation_id, message_id, tool_name, tool_type, arguments, result, status, duration_ms, error_message, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_tool_call (conversation_id, message_id, tool_name, tool_type, arguments, result, status, duration_ms, error_message) VALUES (#{conversationId}, #{messageId}, #{toolName}, #{toolType}, #{arguments}, #{result}, #{status}, #{durationMs}, #{errorMessage})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ai_tool_call WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_tool_call t INNER JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.id = t.conversation_id

SELECT t.id, t.conversation_id, t.message_id, t.tool_name, t.tool_type, t.arguments, t.result, t.status, t.duration_ms, t.error_message, t.created_at FROM ai_tool_call t INNER JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.id = t.conversation_id
ORDER BY t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
